body:
Duplicate of #86286 (see comments there for further explanation). --- Here's a modified `manager.gd` from the MRP showing the scene change doesn't take 2 frames (see the frame numbers at the line beginning):
Modified `manager.gd` (click to expand)

```gdscript extends Node const new_scene = preload("res://secondary.tscn") @onready var tree := get_tree() func next_scene() -> void: info("before tree.change_scene_to_packed(new_scene)") tree.change_scene_to_packed(new_scene) info("after tree.change_scene_to_packed(new_scene)") children.call_deferred() children_one_frame.call_deferred() children_two_frames.call_deferred() func children() -> void: info("Deferred") func children_one_frame() -> void: await tree.process_frame info("Deferred, then `await process_frame` once") func children_two_frames() -> void: await tree.process_frame await tree.process_frame info("Deferred, then `await process_frame` twice") func info(msg: String) -> void: print("[%4d] %-50s root.children: %s" % [Engine.get_process_frames(), msg, get_tree().root.get_children()]) ```

Example output v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]: ``` [ 20] before tree.change_scene_to_packed(new_scene) root.children: [Manager:, Control:] [ 20] after tree.change_scene_to_packed(new_scene) root.children: [Manager:] [ 20] Deferred root.children: [Manager:] [ 20] Deferred, then `await process_frame` once root.children: [Manager:] [ 21] Deferred, then `await process_frame` twice root.children: [Manager:, Label:] ``` #102986 should resolve both #86286 and this issue by providing a reliable signal to await for when changing scene. --- Regarding different behavior in 4.1: postponing the scene change / making it non-instanteous was done intentionally in #78988. Example output v4.1.4.stable.official [fe0e8e557]: ``` [ 272] before tree.change_scene_to_packed(new_scene) root.children: [Manager:, Control:] [ 272] after tree.change_scene_to_packed(new_scene) root.children: [Manager:, Control:] [ 272] Deferred root.children: [Manager:, Label:] [ 273] Deferred, then `await process_frame` once root.children: [Manager:, Label:] [ 274] Deferred, then `await process_frame` twice root.children: [Manager:, Label:] ``` Example output v4.2.2.stable.official [15073afe3]: ``` [ 24] before tree.change_scene_to_packed(new_scene) root.children: [Manager:, Control:] [ 24] after tree.change_scene_to_packed(new_scene) root.children: [Manager:] [ 24] Deferred root.children: [Manager:] [ 24] Deferred, then `await process_frame` once root.children: [Manager:] [ 25] Deferred, then `await process_frame` twice root.children: [Manager:, Label:] ```
